page.layout: One column of running text, with a short marginal note in the right margin beside the Cinnabaris paragraph. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword at bottom right of the column.

main_text.p: Unde patet terram ejus esse aream, cum mercurio & sulphure terreo.
Fit ex omnibus metallis per artem, maxime ex aere & ferro.
Itaq; omnium sulphur hinc alumi-nosum seu atramentosum dicitur.
Cinnabaris est corpus minerale, Cinna-baris.colo-ris sanguinei, constans potissimum sulphure & argento vivo mutuo comprehensis, & in duritie lapideam concretis.

Illa Minium secundarium est, praeterq; sulphur & hydrargyrum etiam arenas continet, & saxi specie invenitur in fodinis: haec ex solo sulphure & hydrargyro commistis fit per sublimationem, habetq; usum in metallica & medicinis primarium.

In metallica chymica figitur, & in tincturam mutatur; vel etiam ex fixa argentum vivum excoquitur, vel aquis gradatoriis materia est. In medicina tam foris in unguentis e fumo adhibetur ad Gallicam, &c. quam intus, sed correcta per metalla perfecta.

page.notes: The faint mark at the upper right of the right margin, near the first lines of the Cinnabaris paragraph, is show-through or stain and is not transcribed. The margin note "Cinnabaris" is split across two lines as "Cinna-" / "baris." and is transcribed with the hyphen as printed. Paragraph breaks follow the short lines ending in full stops; the printed text may have each short sentence as its own paragraph.
